subject: Acme POC: access, success criteria, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Acme POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC so we have alignment: 

Success criteria (what will make this a win for Acme):
- End-to-end integration that demonstrates 95th percentile latency under 200ms for your core invoice summarization flow (50k tokens/day).
- Repeatable accuracy on our agreed prompt set: F1 >= 0.88 across the 20 eval prompts you shared.
- Integration patterns validated: SSO + scoped service account, and a fallback API key for CI tests.

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): access provisioning, SSO invite + one scoped API key for test scripts.
- Week 1: ingest sample dataset, run baseline prompts, collect metrics.
- Week 2: iterate on batching/quantization profile; measure cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Week 3: handshake and success criteria verification; handoff to engineering for rollout plan.

Ownership:
- Redwood: Neha (SE) will own provisioning and evaluation support; Michael (eng) will provide the test API key and IP allowlist config.
- Acme: Alex (product) and Priya (IT/security) to own acceptance decisions and provide IPs/SSO contact.

Access requests we need from Acme to provision immediately:
1) Primary SSO contact for SAML/SCIM invites (email) — if you prefer, we can send invites to the group email.
2) A short list of test IPs (CIDR) to add to our allowlist for the first week of testing.
3) If SSO will be delayed, confirm who should receive the scoped API key and for how long (we suggest 30d expiration for POC keys).

Attachments: redwood-poc-mop.pdf (POC plan / checklist)

Proposed next steps: 
- You confirm SSO contact and/or list of test IPs by EOD Wednesday 7/22.
- Redwood to provision SSO or issue scoped API key within 24 hours of that info.
- Quick sync mid-week if anything blocks.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you started.

— Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acme.com>, IT Ops <it-ops@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Thanks Marissa — great recap. A few quick answers: 

- We prefer SSO for day-to-day use (security policy). That said, our infra team needs a service account / scoped API key for automated CI tests while SSO is setup.
- I've looped in Priya and IT Ops; Priya will own the SSO contact, and IT Ops will provide the IP list.
- For the API key: 30d expiration is fine for POC. Please scope it to non-prod and restrict to the test endpoints.

Priya / IT Ops: can you confirm the SSO contact and a small set of IPs (CIDR) we can provide?

Appreciate the speedy turnaround.

— Alex
Product Manager, Acme Financial
alex.jenkins@acme.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acme.com>, IT Ops <it-ops@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 14:20:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC: access, success criteria, and next steps 

Hi team — Neha here (SE) — quick note with details so you can provision: 

SSO / SCIM:
- We support SAML 2.0 for SSO and can accept standard attribute mappings (email, name, groups).
- If you want us to initiate the invite, send the SAML metadata URL or the IdP contact and we'll create the SSO config.

Service account / API key (short-term):
- We can issue a scoped API key named: acme-poc-test-<env>.
- Recommended scopes: generate, embed, read_metrics.
- Default expiration: 30d (we can shorten on request).
- Example header for requests: Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED-KEY-PREFIX> (we will only return the last 6 chars in email for security).

IP allowlist format:
- Please provide list as CIDR blocks (e.g., 203.0.113.12/32). We'll accept up to 10 entries for the POC.

Attached: poa-instructions.txt (step-by-step SSO & API key runbook).

If you want, Michael can pre-create the scoped key and we'll rotate it after you validate.

Thanks — I'll be on standby for the metadata or IPs.

— Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0147
